title: A tempting offer
text: Each player gets a tempting offer on their phone.

title: Add the catch
text: Write a catch that makes it a tough call.

scene.type: you can never sit down again

title: The room votes
text: Everyone else votes whether they'd take the deal.

title: Aim for 50/50
text: The closer the room splits to 50/50, the more the author scores. Voters on the minority side get a bravery bonus.
